names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 16 Μαΐου, «Όσιοι Κασσιανός και Λαυρέντιος», with the rank word left off; the page's own head line for him reads «Οσιος Κασσιανος (; - 1537)».

The nominative the day page's own `/name/` link carries in its `title`, «Преподобный Кассиан Комельский, Вологодский», with the rank word «Преподобный» left off — it is the `venerable` this folder carries in `types` — and both place epithets kept, which is the fullest form this calendar gives him. The day's own line declines him inside a joint heading, «Прпп. Кассиана (1537) и Лаврентия (1548) Комельских.» `fk.mjs` on this form returned NONE before the write.

death.note: saint.gr: «Ο Όσιος Κασσιανός κοιμήθηκε με ειρήνη το 1537», and its head line reads «Οσιος Κασσιανος (; - 1537)».

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 16 мая ст. ст. — «Прпп. Кассиана (1537) и Лаврентия (1548) Комельских.»

attestations.note: The same menologion day the folder already keeps for the Greek, and the same man: the disciple of Cornelius who governed the house at Komel while his teacher was away at lake Sura, and who died in 1537. `dates` were not touched — 1537 is the year both books give, and this page adds only that he died before his teacher did. **`abbot` was added to `types`**, which held `venerable` alone: both Russian readings say «Избранный братией игуменом с благословения и согласия преподобного Корнилия», chosen abbot by the brethren with his teacher's blessing and consent, and that he gave the office up again on the teacher's return. The line is a joint one and its other half is Laurence of Komel, whose own folder took its russian row in the same batch. Both readings behind the line cite the same chapter of the Komel rule, «О церковном благочинии и о соборной молитве». The day page prints no hymn for either of them. azbyka.ru was not read.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 16ης Μαΐου — «Όσιοι Κασσιανός και Λαυρέντιος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 16 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **One listed line, two head names and two dates** — «Οσιος Κασσιανος (; - 1537)» and «Οσιος Λαυρεντιος (; - 1548)» — and two paragraphs, one for each; so it is an enumerated pair and therefore two folders, one each. **He is none of the corpus's five Cassians**: not of Axylou, of Bosoi, of Glyphia in Cyprus, the Greek, nor John Cassian; this is the disciple of Cornelius of Komel who kept his ascesis in the monastery of Komel. **Cornelius of Komel is named by the page and the corpus keeps no folder for him**, so he is named in the life without a link; `arsenius-of-komel` is a different man of the same monastery and is not brought in on the strength of the place. **No hymn, no birthplace, no parents, no relics.**
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
